title: Survey Sunday: this is how Chinese EVs will make it to America
summary: For the last few weeks, we’ve been running a sidebar survey how (or if) Electrek readers think the first Chinese electric cars will make it onto US roads. After receiving more than 3,000 responses, here’s what you told us.

title: Pony.ai to put 100,000 autonomous electric trucks on the road by 2030 [video]
summary: Chinese autonomy experts Pony.ai are planning to put 1,000 autonomous electric commercial trucks to work by 2027, but it’s the company’s plans to put 100,000 self-driving trucks on the road by 2030 that’s making headlines.

title: Paris now requires electric scooter riders to wear high-vis vests or face fines
summary: Paris is getting tougher on electric scooter safety, with new rules now requiring riders to wear both a helmet and a high-visibility vest while using their scooters on public roads.

title: Zero will pay new riders to get on electric motorcycles… just not in the US
summary: Zero Motorcycles has launched a new incentive program that offers cash back to newly licensed riders who purchase one of the company’s electric motorcycles or scooters. It’s an interesting way to encourage new motorcyclists to skip internal combustion and go electric from day one.

title: Sneaky safari: Thula Solutions’ electric 4×4 gets you closer to nature [video]
summary: Thula Solutions’ new electric safari vehicles aren’t repurposed diesels – they were engineered from the ground up as purpose-built electric safari vehicles designed to get curious tourists, scientists, and park workers closer to the action than ever before.

title: Heavy equipment space race heats up with new Vermeer lunar excavator [update]
summary:
International equipment manufacturer Vermeer has unveiled a full-scale prototype of its Interlune excavator, a machine designed to ingest 100 metric tons of rocks and dirt per hour, extracting valuable helium as it makes its way across the surface … of the Moon.

UPDATE 08AUG26: Interlune and Vermeer have expand their partnership.

title: GM is making EV charging a LOT easier
summary: In mid-June GM hosted their 2026 Empower event, where they made several major announcements. But there are two in particular that will be big benefits to the day-to-day electric vehicle driver, especially when it comes to charging GM brand EVs.

title: Volkswagen’s new electric era begins with reveal of ID. ERA 5X SUV
summary: Revealed in a new filing from China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), the new VW ID. ERA 5X electric SUV is the first pure BEV on the brand’s new Compact Main Platform (CMP) platform.

title: NYC declares war on fast e-bikes, sends cease-and-desist letters to Amazon and Walmart
summary: Micromobility regulation continues to tighten in New York City, and now Mayor Zohran Mamdani is taking aim at the online retailers that have become a major source of high-speed electric bikes and scooters.

title: Kia’s larger electric van caught with less camo ahead of its ‘big’ debut [Images]
summary: Kia’s first electric van is already a top seller, but the larger PV7 is set to launch soon, which could prove to be an even “bigger” hit. Here’s a closer look at it.

title: What Rivian And Lucid's Latest Earnings Say About The EV Startup Race
summary: America's two biggest EV startups are facing more distinct challenges than ever, as Rivian launches the R2 and Lucid delays the Cosmos.

title: How Much Quicker Is The Newest Version Of Tesla FSD? This Test Put It Against Old Software To Find Out
summary: A YouTuber put three Teslas in a back-to-back test to measure reaction time. The results showed how both hardware and software have progressed.

title: Subaru Is Spending Three Times More To Sell EVs Than Gas Cars. It's Not Working
summary: The company’s U.S. marketing expenses reportedly increased 40% last quarter, with most of the money going to EVs.

title: What To Know About California's $3,500 EV Rebate—And Which Teslas Qualify
summary: California dropped new details about how its incentive program for new and used EVs works, and which cars qualify. Here's what we know.

title: Clemson's Solar-Powered EV Project Looks Like A Cardboard Shoe. But It's A Lot More Clever Than It Looks
summary: BMW challenged graduate students from Clemson University to create an energy-positive car that produces more electricity than it uses. This is what they came up with.

title: Toyota Will Modernize Your Aging Plug-In With Its Factory Upgrade Program
summary: Toyota is expanding a factory-backed upgrade program designed to breathe new life into aging gas and plug-in Toyota and Lexus cars.

title: BMW's Oldest Plant Has Always Made Gas Cars. Starting Next Year, It'll Only Make EVs
summary: Now that i3 production has started at BMW's Munich plant, its days of producing gas-powered cars are numbered.

title: Ford's Affordable Electric Truck Finally Has A Name And A Price
summary: The $29,945 Ford Fathom gets a pretty decent list of standard equipment.

title: The Mercedes-AMG GT 53 EV Trades Power For Over 500 Miles Of Range
summary: The entry-level AMG four-door EV uses one fewer motor than the GT 63, yet still makes 536 hp and hits 60 mph in 3.8 seconds.

title: Lucid Cosmos Mid-Size SUV: Here’s A First Look At The Tesla Model Y Rival
summary: The company’s smallest EV to date is expected to cost around $50,000, opening up a much more lucrative market for the startup.
